name: Bomb Busters

categories.label: Mission completed (all tile stands empty)
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ (mọi giá đỡ đã hết dây)
categories.hint: Win only if every expert's wires are all cut before any explosion.

categories.label: Detonator dial advances (wrong guesses)
categories.labelVi: Số lần kim kíp nổ tiến (đoán sai)
categories.hint: +1 each failed Dual Cut on a blue/yellow wire. Reaching the skull space blows up the bomb.

categories.label: Red wire cut (instant explosion)
categories.hint: Cutting or wrongly targeting a red wire ends the mission in failure.

endCondition.description: Mission ends in success when all tile stands are empty; in failure when a red wire is cut or the detonator dial reaches the skull space (then restart with a new Captain).

winCondition: Cooperative per mission: cut every wire (all tile stands empty) without cutting a red wire or letting the detonator dial reach the skull. No points; record each mission as won/lost.
notes: family: coop. 66 missions with mission-specific setup/special rules (not modelled). Each failed mission is restarted with a new Captain. Unofficial fan score sheets exist but the official rules define no points.
